facts.fact: 她把他带回自己公寓——正是感恩节寄派那间 unit 1094
facts.anchor: The same unit where I’d sent her a pie for Thanksgiving.

facts.fact: 照片墙考古：Dartmouth 冰上照与Frasier、Derek并肩；童年兄妹户外冰场合影
facts.anchor: There was a picture of Logan on the ice in a Dartmouth uniform, flanked by Frasier and Derek.

facts.fact: 她把印自己名字的球衣送他，谢Emerson的号码
facts.anchor: She held out a folded jersey with her name on the back.

facts.fact: 航班取消（O’Hare ground stop）+寄存包拿不到=没电脑没眼镜
facts.anchor: With my carry-on bag unavailable, I had no laptop, no glasses.

facts.fact: 她拍沙发留客：再待一会儿陪我
facts.anchor: “Stay a little while. Hang out with me.”

facts.fact: 他自知动了真心：从不恋爱的人想要关系
facts.anchor: I didn’t do relationships. And yet, I wanted to be in a relationship with her. I wanted her.

facts.fact: 他离家时妹妹们5/7/11岁，如今10/12/16岁，错过一切
facts.anchor: When I’d left home, my younger sisters had been five, seven, and eleven. They were now ten, twelve, and sixteen.

facts.fact: 重磅：五年没和家人说过话
facts.anchor: I hadn’t spoken to my family since I’d moved out five years ago.

facts.fact: 她说Levi是最爱的人之一，他顿时觉得自己不属于这里
facts.anchor: her words a reminder that I didn’t belong. Not in her apartment, nor in her life.

facts.fact: 他澄清不恨Levi，心里补刀：Because you’re important to me too
facts.anchor: “I don’t despise him,” I finally said.

facts.fact: 她提供客房，原句召回他去年船上那句living in a hotel
facts.anchor: “You could stay here tonight. I have a guest bedroom. It would give you a break from feeling like you’re living in a hotel.”

facts.fact: 结尾：他问“你哥呢”，她答“我哥我来操心”
